messages:
Ana R: Morning pulse — queue at ~42 (4 P1s, 9 P2s, rest P3). Notable: embed jobs failing intermittently in eu-west-1, started ~02:10 UTC. Using a temporary macro to surface users: embed-retry-eu :warning:
Sam K: saw the alerts, digging into the transformer-worker logs. If it’s the kv-cache serialization error again I’ll flip the retry backoff. ETA 30m. :hourglass_flowing_sand:
Leo M: I can pick up the P1 list. Assign ticket #8871 and #8873 to me, starting now. Leaving note on the thread when I triage. :thumbsup:
Ana R: @Nadia P can you gate the macro swap? Want to swap in embed-retry-eu for affected tickets and roll back if errors spike. Steps: 1) run /apply-macro embed-retry-eu --env production 2) monitor errors 3) rollback with /apply-macro embed-default if needed
Nadia P: copying steps to runbook. I’ll run the macro in 5m and watch logs for error rate and latency. Will post the shortcheck stats every 5m.
triage-bot: automated summary — last 1h: 42 new tickets, 17 closed, avg time to first response 11m. Top tag: embeddings (38%). Alert: 3 failures from eu-west-1 cluster alpha-3.
Sam K: quick log snippet I’m seeing: ```error: KVCache: failed to deserialize entry, key=usr-2324, err=unexpected EOF``` possible cause: partial checkpoint write during pod restart. Patching marshal logic in PR #612.
Ana R: PR #612 needs a quick review for hotfix. @Sam K can you post the short diff? I’ll try to review before noon.
Sam K: posted diff: https://git.internal/r/612 — it’s small, adds a fallback and metric. Ping me if you want me to deploy canary after review.
Leo M: triage update: I picked up #8871 (customer impacted) — repro steps documented, sent initial DM to customer, escalated to Eng for embed-side follow-up. Moving #8873 to in-progress.
Nadia P: macro applied. First 5m checks: errors unchanged (3 -> 3), avg embed latency down 8%. Continuing watch.
Ana R: Thanks all — blockers: waiting on PR review + Sam’s canary. If both green, plan: run batch rollback window 11:30-11:45 UTC and follow with postmortem notes. Anything else urgent?
Leo M: I’ll remap two high-heat customers to dedicated routing to avoid eu-west-1 while we stabilize. Will update ticket comments.
Sam K: thanks — I’ll prioritize PR review now. Will report back in ~20m.
Ana R: good. Short reminders: please tag macros used in ticket comments, and add "macro=embed-retry-eu" label when applied. :memo:
Nadia P: noted. Posting monitoring snapshot in 10.
triage-bot: next automated check scheduled in 4m.
